2608.18580.title: FACET: Preserving Source Intent and Executable State in Terminal Task Synthesis
2608.18580.paper_summary: Training terminal agents requires scalable executable supervision, yet synthesizing high-quality terminal tasks remains challenging. Each task couples an instruction, an initialized environment, a reference solution, and an executable verifier; if these artifacts are generated from inconsistent assumptions, the resulting task may be unsolvable or incorrectly evaluated. Meanwhile, multi-stage synthesis can discard the goals, dependencies, state transitions, and procedural constraints encoded in the original sources. We present FACET (Fine-grained Agentic Construction of Executable Tasks), a framework that addresses both information preservation and cross-artifact consistency. FACET reconstructs related agent skills into coherent, information-rich scenarios, then realizes and repairs the execution environment before generating the final task artifacts. The resulting container state serves as shared grounding for the instruction, solution, and verifier, while execution-based validation and targeted repair correct artifact-specific failures without unnecessarily regenerating valid components. FACET produces complex terminal tasks with dense executable checks, and successful trajectories collected from these tasks provide effective, data-efficient supervision. Fine-tuning models across multiple scales consistently improves performance on Terminal-Bench 2.1, while analyses of alternative generation schemes support the importance of environment-grounded construction for task validity and solution-verifier alignment. These results establish source-intent preservation and shared executable-state grounding as key principles for scalable terminal-task synthesis.
2608.18580.paper_summary_zh: 訓練終端代理需要可擴展的可執行監督，但合成高品質的終端任務仍然具有挑戰性。每個任務都結合了一個指令、一個初始化的環境、一個參考解決方案和一個可執行的驗證器；如果這些工件是基於不一致的假設生成的，則生成的任務可能無法解決或被錯誤評估。與此同時，多階段合成可能會丟棄原始來源中編碼的目標、依賴關係、狀態轉換和程序約束。我們提出了FACET（可執行任務的細粒度代理構建），這是一個同時解決信息保留和跨工件一致性的框架。FACET將相關的代理技能重建為連貫且信息豐富的場景，然後實現並修復執行環境，最後生成最終的任務工件。生成的容器狀態作為指令、解決方案和驗證器的共享基礎，而基於執行的驗證和針對性的修復則在不必要地重新生成有效組件的情況下修正了特定工件的失敗。FACET生成具有密集可執行檢查的複雜終端任務，並從這些任務中收集的成功軌跡提供了有效且數據高效的監督。在多個尺度上微調模型始終能改善Terminal-Bench 2.1的性能，而對替代生成方案的分析支持環境基礎構建對任務有效性和解決方案-驗證器對齊的重要性。這些結果確立了源意圖保留和共享可執行狀態基礎作為可擴展終端任務合成的關鍵原則。
